title: Announcements/Balancing Data
html:
Balancing Data

Note: This is action on Typical Developers Discord server started by @Jak. If you would like to help, please create a copy of the sheet and fill it out as much as you like.

Once you are done ping @Jak on this channel.

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Start your timer at your plot, and end it when you sell your material
  • Make sure that you are using the correct equipment. The equipment/setups for each setup for each stage are listed below (and in spreadsheet)
  • Leave the $/min section blank, I will fill that out so all calculations are consistent

If you have questions, ask @Jak!

Stages

  • Stage one (trees) - Rusty axe, Saw, Rusty Sander, Joop barrow(no automation)
  • Stage one(rocks/ores) - rusty pickaxe, chisel, rusty forge and refinery (no automation)
  • Stage two(trees) - metal axe, metal saw, metal sander, metal planker (some automation- basic loader/ unloader)
  • Stage two(rocks) - metal pickaxe, chisel, metal forge and refinery (some automation-basic unloader/loader)
  • Stage three(trees) - refined axe, refined saw, metal sander, metal planker (some automation- basic loader/ unloader)
  • Stage three(rocks) - refined pickaxe, refined chisel, metal forge and refinery (some automation)
